typographic-hierarchy-as-command-presenc.prior: Monumental display type against precise microtype makes critical counts read instantly while labels stay legible, so the console feels authoritative and scannable under pressure.

color-as-signal-meaning.prior: color should carry information about what each signal is and what state it's in, so meaning is read instantly rather than decoded from labels

immersive-signal-field.prior: the operator reads a live situation best when content fills the view and details float over it, so attention stays on the signals themselves rather than on framing

ambient-liveness.prior: continuous ambient motion reassures the viewer the feed is alive and signals are updating in real time, so a still screen never reads as a frozen or stale view

depth-conveys-signal-priority.prior: layering panels and overlays on diffuse, tinted shadows lets the operator instantly read what's foreground versus context so the most urgent signals rise visibly above the ambient field

tactile-surface-realism.prior: Rendering the focal object as a physically lit, crafted material makes it read as a real, dependable instrument worth trusting with live signals.

state-change-as-legible-event.prior: when the view shifts, treat the transition itself as something to be witnessed so the operator trusts what changed and never loses their bearings on the signal landscape

spatial-situational-awareness.prior: Keeping the live signal field as one continuous spatial canvas lets a person read the whole situation at a glance and drill into any detail without losing their place.

_guide.deployment_frequency: An identity move has a HOME. Carrying a move does NOT mean maximizing it: the source deploys its strongest moves — textures, glows, loops, display type — at a specific frequency (the checklist's DEPLOYMENT notes give the observed rate), and that restraint is itself part of the identity. Applying a reserved move to every element destroys the figure/ground contrast that makes it read as identity; the build goes noisy and one-dimensional, and the gate flags clear over-application. Match the deployment pattern, not just the move.
_guide.omission_is_identity: What the product LEAVES OUT is as binding as what it adds. Agents reach for their defaults — shadows, icons, toasts, spinners, confirm dialogs, hover lifts — and each one quietly erodes an identity built on refusing it. Every SUBTRACTION on the checklist is a requirement, not a gap to fill; if a need seems to demand the omitted thing, use the product's substitute instead.
_guide.build_to_the_why: The checklist's WHY clauses are the product's dispositions — its soul. Build to those principles, not just to pass the checks. A check is a floor, not the finish: passing conformance means you didn't violate the grammar, NOT that it feels like one designer's hand.
build_order: 1. SKELETON — stand up the composition spine and the focal object first (structure before style). A great skin on no spine reads as generic.
2. MATERIAL — give the focal object its layered material (the SURFACE moves).
3. BEHAVIOR — bind the interaction grammar (gesture → response) on the component roles.
4. STYLE — carry each facet's moves at the stated MAGNITUDE (as loud as the source, not a tasteful echo).
5. POLISH — the craft below. This is where a passing build becomes a good one.

you_own_these_the_gate_cannot_check.note: Static analysis reads declared DOM/CSS, not the rendered/animated result. These are real identity but UNVERIFIABLE — a green report does NOT cover them, so they are yours to get right by hand.
you_own_these_the_gate_cannot_check.motion_smoothness: Real easing and staged timing — no linear tweens, no jank. Animate transform/opacity, not layout. Honor prefers-reduced-motion.
you_own_these_the_gate_cannot_check.color_harmony: The palette must read as ONE system — even lightness/chroma steps, restrained hue families. Passing the color moves ≠ a harmonious palette.
you_own_these_the_gate_cannot_check.type_layout: Clean arrangement — aligned to a grid, consistent vertical rhythm, a hierarchy that reads. (Rich size vocabularies are fine; sloppy ARRANGEMENT is not.)
you_own_these_the_gate_cannot_check.material_feel: Glossy vs flat, focal richness — the rendered richness the layer/alpha counts can't distinguish. Make the focal object look genuinely lit.

_guide.reading_the_gate: The gate is DETERMINISTIC except color, which is semantic (marking-vs-decoration is a judgment about meaning). Consequences: (a) a FAIL that stays IDENTICAL on UNCHANGED code is REAL — fix the build, do not re-run hoping it clears, and do not contort code to game a signature. (b) The color check can shift between edits because it re-reads meaning; trust a stable verdict on unchanged code. (c) 'accent decorates instead of marks' is about MEANING: a colored glow on a data entity MARKS (good); a decorative gradient DECORATES (flagged).
